title: Great Northern War
summary: A conflict in which Russia, Denmark-Norway and Saxony-Poland challenged Swedish supremacy in the Baltic. Charles XII won early at Narva, but Russia defeated Sweden at Poltava in 1709. The Treaty of Nystad (1721) gave Russia Ingria, Estonia and Livonia, ending Swedish influence and establishing Russia as a major regional power.
